evaluation machinery for the annotator program; the transferable requirement — material shown to an independent reviewer/adjudicator must not leak the answer-key vocabulary and must bind each presented case to exactly one dataset identity and a real evidence anchor — is real but is an owner decision for the target lifecycle

The reusable requirement — model-facing text pinned to a recorded version and reproduced verbatim so repairs, replays and provenance stamps refer to the same bytes — is mechanism-agnostic and needed wherever a bounded model call participates in a gated lifecycle. Existing index entries (worker-B075) record [source-symbol] as provenance but do not cover the reproduction/refusal/version-isolation contract itself; the specific v9 guidance wording is omitted machinery.

Collision-safe run identity with evidence/workspace tree separation and fresh-[source-symbol]-on-retained-workspace resume is a reusable target invariant (unique run directory prevents evidence overwrite and gives resume an honest new attempt identity); only the non-atomic reservation check needs target hardening, not redesign.
Target stable host/repository identity must replace source display-name equivalence; policy scope/provenance remain necessary.
Retain boundary/completeness/secret/unknown contracts; source MCP requirement, exact CLI schemas and personal bindings are optional mechanisms.
